newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends steady but seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends steady but seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed steady at 42.25 to the dollar on Friday amid rising demand for the U.S. currency sparked by rumours of a devaluation, dealers said.
No official comment was available concerning the rumour but dealers said high demand for the dollar will keep the rupee under pressure on Saturday.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, changed on May 23, was 40.3900/40.5920 against the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed steady at 4.20 percent.
Dealers earlier speculated that the rupee was overvalued and could face a five percent devaluation over the next month. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
